rationale: The candidate reads as a single coherent terraced bar in all four views, so gesture and hierarchy are strong. The stepped silhouette is not arbitrary stair-logic; it forms one continuous landform-like mass with a stable top datum. However, the public-void logic is weak: the courtyard/undercut is present but not especially legible or generous in plan or section, so the access-edge response feels only partially resolved. The mass is still plausible for neighborhood living because it supports a compact mixed-use bar with a differentiated upper form, but the ground threshold would benefit from a clearer carved entry/court relation to the verified frontage. No visible view-to-view collision issues read as a hard failure.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stepped massing can remain coherent when it reads as one dominant compact volume with a clear upper datum and a legible carved public edge.
